bundle.shortDescription: Lightweight desktop client for the Hermes agent: connect, pick a session, chat with streamed replies.
bundle.longDescription: hermes-legal desktop is a thin client for a running Hermes agent. It connects to the Hermes API server with a host, port and token, shows connection health, lists sessions, streams chat replies and shows approval prompts when the server exposes them. It does not embed or start the agent and starts no other process.
